title: A capture you place from the Library keeps its own name
goal: When you drop a capture from the Library into a picture, the new layer is called "Pasted Image". It should be called what the file is called, so a stack of placed captures is readable in the layers list.
notes: Came out of the Library panel task (2026-09-03). EditorState.placeLibraryPick -> addImageLayerOrOpen -> pasteImage, which hardcodes the Pasted Image name. Give the image-landing path an optional name and pass the URLs last path component from both the Library and the Finder drop.
acceptance: Placing a capture from the Library names the layer after the file, without its extension
Dropping an image file from the Finder names the layer the same way
Pasting an image from the clipboard, which has no file name, still reads Pasted Image
Renaming the layer afterwards still works and survives undo

log.note: Adversarial review before building: the literal ask (full file name) FAILS its own stated goal. A capture is named 'Screenshot 2026-09-02 at 16.22.12', which measures ~220pt of text; the Layers panel is 220pt wide including thumbnail, indent and eye button, so every placed capture would truncate to the identical 'Screenshot 2026-09-02 a...' - less readable than Pasted Image, not more. Measured with NSFont before deciding. The Library tiles already hit this and answer it with a relative time (LibraryNaming.caption), which reads well on a tile but goes stale on a layer.

Built the better thing: a file a person named keeps its whole name minus extension; a capture the app named itself keeps the part that tells two apart, the clock time ('Screenshot 16.22.12'). Recorded as a deviation in the audit's rough so the user can push back on it.

PhotonzCore/PlacedImageNaming.swift (new, 10 tests written first, all green). Strict date check so 'Screenshot of the cat at night' is not mistaken for a capture. EditorState.pasteImage gained a fileName argument; addImageLayerOrOpen passes url.lastPathComponent, so the Library place and the Finder drop both get it, and the clipboard path passes nothing and still reads Pasted Image.
Added a renameSelectedLayer playtest action: the layers dock cannot be reached with the pointer from a walk, so this is the only way to prove acceptance 4.

Verified in the probe app with Scripts/playtest/placed-image-name-walk.json (Screen Recording granted, real captures). Layer tree per stage: Finder drop -> 'Hero banner'; Library place -> 'Screenshot 16.22.12'; clipboard paste -> 'Pasted Image'; rename -> 'Renamed Layer'; undo -> 'Pasted Image'. All four acceptance items met.

Review of the built thing: names fit the panel with room to spare (see 2026-09-03-placed-image-names-2-three-names.png). Left alone: two copies of the same file get identical rows, and the Library tile says '9 hours ago' where the layer says 'Screenshot 16.22.12'. Both are in the audit as questions.
Scripts/test.sh green: 1970 tests in 198 suites. EditorState is shared, not forked into Next, so both releases have it.

Placed pictures are named after their file: Finder drop -> 'Hero banner', Library place -> 'Screenshot 16.22.12', clipboard -> 'Pasted Image'.
